identity_metadata.abstract: <jats:p>Achieving global coverage and performance goals for 6G requires seamless integration of satellite and terrestrial networks, yet current operational frameworks lack common standards for managing these heterogeneous infrastructures. This paper addresses the critical need for unified satellite-terrestrial network operations by proposing the CMS framework, a novel task-scheduling-based approach that bridges the operational gap between satellite operations (SatOps) and network operations (NetOps). The framework integrates satellite-specific constraints with network service requirements and QoS metrics through constraint satisfaction programming and multi-objective optimization. Three novel architectures are introduced: integrated operations (embedding NetOps within SatOps), coordinated operations (unified control with separate execution channels), and adaptive operations (mutual adaptation through intelligent interfaces). Each architecture addresses different connectivity scenarios and integration requirements for both sporadic and persistent satellite constellations. The proposed architectures are evaluated against challenges spanning infrastructure and architecture, interoperability and standardization, integrated management, operational dynamics, and technology maturation and deployment. Validation through simulation demonstrates significant performance improvements, with task completion rates improving by 17.87% to 44.02% and data throughput gains of 25.09% to 93.62% compared to traditional approaches. The CMS framework establishes a resilient operational standard for future 6G networks, offering practical solutions to bridge the current divide between satellite and terrestrial network operations.</jats:p>
title: Toward Integrated Satellite Operations and Network Management: A Review and Novel Framework

record.version: publisher_typeset_article_in_institutional_repository
record.version_observation: PDF Technologies 2025, 13, 312, MDPI layout and DOI
locators: Sections 3-3.2.3, PDF pages 16-19, Figures 1-2 and Algorithm 1
Section 4 and Sections 4.2-4.3, PDF pages 20 and 23-25, Figures 3 and 9-10
shared_variables: satellite, target and start time assignments
record.decision_process: Construction heuristic initializes a task schedule, then local search refines it under hierarchical scoring. Plan Executor updates contacts, resource states and remaining/failed tasks before requesting rescheduling.

architecture_distinctions.coordinated: CMS coordinates plans executed separately through satellite operations and MANO
architecture_distinctions.adaptive: CMS and NTN-MANO exchange intent and operational plans, then form respective actions

record.experiment_object: Core prototype validation summarizes a 16-satellite LEO simulation against a semi-manual best-effort operator without business-criteria optimization; scaling measurements additionally described separately.
record.result_boundary: Prototype implemented in integrated architecture; reported simulation does not compare all three architecture types on a common scenario. Paper's CubeSat validation is prospective at publication, not a completed flight result. Quantitative improvements are not reproduced in the proposal.
not_supported: all three architectures proven in flight
planned 2025/2026 trials confirmed completed as of current date

record.title: Edge Intelligence for Satellite-Based Earth Observation: Scheduling Image Acquisition and Processing
record.source_version: arXiv 2604.05937v1 author preprint dated 2026-04-07; publisher page identifies this as a prior preprint of the published manuscript; differences not fully checked
record.publisher_identity_observation: Official page identifies the same title and authors, first publication 2026-08-24, and links arXiv2604.05937 in Data Availability. The full-text link redirected to the abstract page.
checked_locations: Section 3, functional layers and Figure 4 workflow
Section 3.4, scatter/process/gather pipeline and communication assumptions
Sections 4.1-4.2, P_obs and P_sch formulations, equations 18 and 26-33

claims.fact: P_obs maximizes observation profit based on image quality using binary window/order decisions with time, attitude, and energy constraints. Storage is neglected under dynamic processing. SCIP is used for this ILP.

P_sch uses acquired workload and available downlink schedules as inputs, choosing fractional workload allocation x and processing frequency f to minimize processing plus transmission energy, with processing, ISL and downlink capacity limits. Substituting the frequency expression reduces the stated problem to a convex formulation.

The pipeline scatters data captured at slot k in the same slot, processes in k+1, and gathers for downlink in k+2. Intra-space links are assumed stable/fixed, whereas the ground feeder endpoint and rate can vary.

The processing experiments compare CPU/GPU edge configurations and ground processing under specified loads. Benefits depend on hardware, load and slot length; the longest slot is not simply the best operational choice because observation arrivals can overlap ongoing processing.

claims.interpretation: The concrete implementation combines an acquisition schedule with downstream workload/frequency optimization through a pipeline. It should not be described as a single global optimization jointly choosing observation windows, processor placement and unrestricted routing, or as an already demonstrated feedback controller from processing bottlenecks to acquisition.

selected_numeric_context.primary_observation_layer: one EO satellite; separate four-satellite Walker observation experiments also described
selected_numeric_context.use_in_manuscript: Only include numbers if necessary for the verification-scope comparison, not as evidence of giant-constellation scalability.

unresolved: Detailed formulation and result equality between the arXiv v1 and the formal Wiley version has not been established.
The author preprint text and Table 3 differ on the Nano GPU maximum-power value; do not copy that hardware number into the review without resolving it.
No flight or commercial deployment validation is shown by these numerical and hardware timing results.

funder.name: Space Engineering University

identity_metadata.abstract: <jats:p>Mega-constellation network traffic forecasting provides key information for routing and resource allocation, which is of great significance to the performance of satellite networks. However, due to the self-similarity and long-range dependence (LRD) of mega-constellation network traffic, traditional linear/non-linear forecasting models cannot achieve sufficient forecasting accuracy. In order to resolve this problem, a mega-constellation network traffic forecasting model based on EMD (empirical mode decomposition)-ARIMA (autoregressive integrated moving average) and IGWO (improved grey wolf optimizer) optimized BPNN (back-propagation neural network) is proposed in this paper, which makes comprehensive utilization of linear model ARIMA, non-linear model BPNN and optimization algorithm IGWO. With the enhancement of the global optimization capability of a BPNN, the proposed hybrid model can fully realize the potential of mining linear and non-linear laws of mega-constellation network traffic, hence improving the forecasting accuracy. This paper utilizes an ON/OFF model to generate historical self-similar traffic to forecast. RMSE (root mean square error), MAE (mean absolute error), R-square and MAPE (mean absolute percentage error) are adopted as evaluation indexes for the forecasting effect. Comprehensive experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms traditional constellation network traffic forecasting schemes, with several improvements in forecasting accuracy and efficiency.</jats:p>
title: A Hybrid Forecasting Model for Self-Similar Traffic in LEO Mega-Constellation Networks

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 业务需求预测与波束、功率及频谱分配
manuscript_occurrences.text: 非均匀需求使固定照射与平均资源分配难以同时兼顾资源利用和业务满足。波束跳变通过时分照射覆盖多个区域，其资源配置涉及离散照射选择与连续功率分配。Han等[73](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11030191)结合经验模态分解、ARIMA与优化神经网络，预测具有自相似特征的业务流量，为需求感知调度提供负载估计。波束与功率优化进一步确定有限容量的分配，其评价指标包括供需差距、吞吐和时延，与流量预测误差具有不同的业务含义。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 流量预测[73](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11030191) | 未来业务量 | 自相似负载；预测模型 | 负载估计通过后续调度影响服务效果 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.3 分布式与学习方法的信息条件
manuscript_occurrences.text: 学习方法在上述信息条件下承担不同决策职责。流量预测[73](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11030191)生成未来负载估计；学习辅助大邻域搜索[63](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2025.128502)提供初解，再由破坏—修复搜索形成计划；单星策略复用[65](https://doi.org/10.2514/1.A35736)直接影响成员的在线选择；带安全屏蔽的策略[96](https://doi.org/10.1007/s40295-026-00631-w)在巡检任务中结合动作生成与安全约束。预测、搜索初解和策略动作的改进分别通过后续优化、协调或约束处理影响运行结果。训练阶段的联合信息与执行阶段的成员状态也属于不同信息集合，学习与分布式方法的结合效果取决于局部可得状态对任务安排和冲突消解的支持程度。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.5 研究挑战与发展方向
manuscript_occurrences.text: **学习模块对最终运行结果的贡献。** 预测[73](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11030191)、学习初解与搜索修复[63](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2025.128502)、受安全屏蔽的动作生成[96](https://doi.org/10.1007/s40295-026-00631-w)分别作用于不同决策环节。局部误差或动作质量的改善经资源竞争、协调和约束处理后，可能产生不同的最终收益。其向任务交付或持续服务传递的条件，以及需求变化、通信受限和能力降级对这一过程的影响，构成学习方法的系统评价问题。结合模块职责分析训练投入、后续修复与回退结果，有助于识别学习方法对整体方案的实际贡献。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 业务需求预测与波束、功率及频谱分配
manuscript_occurrences.text: 多星重叠覆盖引入了服务关联和跨星干扰约束。Lin等[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)依次优化卫星—小区关联与照射模式，同时考虑负载平衡及对地球同步轨道系统的同频干扰。Zhao等[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)结合数字孪生与多智能体学习，根据预测需求和队列状态配置多星波束及星内功率。其[公开预印本](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.08896v1)采用12星、每星4波束、总计168小区的模型，限制同一小区的服务关联及功率预算。与单星配置相比，多星模型还需协调重叠覆盖中的重复服务、成员间干扰和排队差异。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 业务需求预测与波束、功率及频谱分配
manuscript_occurrences.text: 上述模型的分解方式与协调对象存在差异。波束—功率配置[74](https://doi.org/10.23919/JCC.ja.2022-0864)和需求感知配置[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)分别处理离散选束与连续功率，多星共存模型[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)则分阶段确定服务关联与照射模式。三类方法对应单星供需匹配、多星资源协调和共存干扰等不同约束。学习方法将部分计算转移至训练阶段，并依赖全局状态或局部观测。因此，联合配置方法的适用范围与其协调尺度、信息条件和计算成本密切相关。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 多星与GSO共存[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912) | 服务关联与照射模式 | 负载平衡及共存干扰约束 | 跨星分配同时受到关联和外部干扰限制 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.2 从局部活动到最终服务的资源耦合
manuscript_occurrences.text: 通信资源耦合作用于持续业务流。单星波束—功率配置[74](https://doi.org/10.23919/JCC.ja.2022-0864)通过连续资源调整改变供需匹配，多星关联和共存模型[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)纳入成员之间及外部系统的干扰约束，需求感知配置[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)中的策略差异随总负载改变。路径时延参与接入选择[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)，容量竞争与故障进入地面中继路由[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)，激光链路建立则增加路径更新代价[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)。资源耦合的作用由这些具体瓶颈决定：照射区域、接入对象和瞬时最短路分别描述服务过程的一部分，功率、后续容量及动作生效时间共同限定实际可获得的服务。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 星地接入、卫星切换与业务连续性
manuscript_occurrences.text: Yin等[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)将端到端传播时延估计纳入切换评价，采用Dueling Double DQN处理单层切换，并在跨层切换中结合时延抖动预测与切换开销。该方法将接入决策的评价范围扩展至后续网络路径，其仿真结果反映路径评价、预测与学习机制共同作用下的整体策略性能。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 路由代价感知切换[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039) | 接入对象与连接保持 | 路径时延、抖动及切换开销 | 接入选择同时考虑端到端路径质量 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.2 从局部活动到最终服务的资源耦合
manuscript_occurrences.text: 通信资源耦合作用于持续业务流。单星波束—功率配置[74](https://doi.org/10.23919/JCC.ja.2022-0864)通过连续资源调整改变供需匹配，多星关联和共存模型[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)纳入成员之间及外部系统的干扰约束，需求感知配置[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)中的策略差异随总负载改变。路径时延参与接入选择[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)，容量竞争与故障进入地面中继路由[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)，激光链路建立则增加路径更新代价[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)。资源耦合的作用由这些具体瓶颈决定：照射区域、接入对象和瞬时最短路分别描述服务过程的一部分，功率、后续容量及动作生效时间共同限定实际可获得的服务。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.5 研究挑战与发展方向
manuscript_occurrences.text: **端到端服务目标下的适度联合。** 接触图调度[106](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.adhoc.2023.103289)共同选择采集与交付路径，观测—处理安排[53](https://doi.org/10.1002/sat.70082)利用既有采集计划配置下游资源；需求感知波束[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)、路由代价感知切换[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)和动态激光链路路由[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)分别引入负载、端到端路径和建链代价。上述差异表明，联合范围取决于后续条件对当前任务或路径选择的影响，以及顺序输入和运行反馈保留这些作用的程度。相同请求、负载与扰动条件下的联合、顺序和反馈模型比较，可通过交付量、时延、计算及协调开销揭示联合范围扩大的收益和代价。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 动态拓扑、星间路由与拥塞恢复
manuscript_occurrences.text: Zhang和Yeung[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)面向无星间链路、地面站辅助的低轨网络，采用分层路由协调路径时延与稳定性。Zhang等[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)同样研究地面中继网络，通过分段路由实现流量工程和故障重路由。前者主要降低正常拓扑演化中的路径更新负担，后者进一步处理容量分配及失效恢复。上述方法的适用对象是地面辅助网络，其链路结构与直接激光星间转发不同。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 分层及分段路由[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)、[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022) | 路径稳定、流量与恢复 | 无直接星间链路的地面辅助网络 | 更新组织、容量分配和失效恢复具有不同职责 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.1 求解机制与可扩展性
manuscript_occurrences.text: 局部化与计划复用在降低计算负担的同时，涉及计划质量与协调范围的权衡。Parjan和Chien[34](https://doi.org/10.2514/1.I011215)在连续规划实验中发现，增量修改的计算速度优于重新生成计划，但产生了更多重复观测。Zilberstein等[35](https://doi.org/10.1613/jair.1.16997)利用几何邻域划分局部问题，在大规模算例中降低最慢代理的计算时间和消息量，任务满足率与比较方法仍存在差距。前者复用已有安排，后者限制协调范围，二者分别通过时间延续性和空间局部性组织计算。地面辅助的稳定路由[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)同样减少路径更新负担，动态激光链路路由[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)则表明路径保持的时延收益取决于建链代价。计划复用与路径保持均利用既有决策的连续性，其效果分别受重复任务、机会损失及动作成本影响。表8归纳主要技术机制及其取舍。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 动态拓扑、星间路由与拥塞恢复
manuscript_occurrences.text: Zhang和Yeung[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)面向无星间链路、地面站辅助的低轨网络，采用分层路由协调路径时延与稳定性。Zhang等[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)同样研究地面中继网络，通过分段路由实现流量工程和故障重路由。前者主要降低正常拓扑演化中的路径更新负担，后者进一步处理容量分配及失效恢复。上述方法的适用对象是地面辅助网络，其链路结构与直接激光星间转发不同。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 分层及分段路由[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)、[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022) | 路径稳定、流量与恢复 | 无直接星间链路的地面辅助网络 | 更新组织、容量分配和失效恢复具有不同职责 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.2 从局部活动到最终服务的资源耦合
manuscript_occurrences.text: 通信资源耦合作用于持续业务流。单星波束—功率配置[74](https://doi.org/10.23919/JCC.ja.2022-0864)通过连续资源调整改变供需匹配，多星关联和共存模型[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)纳入成员之间及外部系统的干扰约束，需求感知配置[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)中的策略差异随总负载改变。路径时延参与接入选择[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)，容量竞争与故障进入地面中继路由[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)，激光链路建立则增加路径更新代价[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)。资源耦合的作用由这些具体瓶颈决定：照射区域、接入对象和瞬时最短路分别描述服务过程的一部分，功率、后续容量及动作生效时间共同限定实际可获得的服务。

funder.name: National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC)

identity_metadata.abstract: <jats:p>The mega-low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation is pivotal for the future of satellite Internet and 6G networks. In the mega-LEO satellite constellation system (MLSCS), which is the spatial distribution of satellites, global users, and their services, along with the utilization of global spectrum resources, significantly impacts resource allocation and scheduling. This paper addresses the challenge of effectively allocating system resources based on service and resource distribution, particularly in hotspot areas where user demand is concentrated, to enhance resource utilization efficiency. We propose a novel three-layer management architecture designed to implement scheduling strategies and alleviate the processing burden on the terrestrial Network Control Center (NCC), while providing real-time scheduling capabilities to adapt to rapid changes in network topology, resource distribution, and service requirements. The three layers of the resource management architecture—NCC, space base station (SBS), and user terminal (UT)—are discussed in detail, along with the functions and responsibilities of each layer. Additionally, we explore various resource scheduling strategies, approaches, and algorithms, including spectrum cognition, interference coordination, beam scheduling, multi-satellite collaboration, and random access. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approaches and algorithms, indicating significant improvements in resource management in the MLSCS.</jats:p>
title: Hierarchical Resource Management for Mega-LEO Satellite Constellation

record.title: A delay-tolerant network approach to satellite pickup and delivery scheduling
record.version: final_published_version_in_institutional_repository
record.version_observation: repository label Final Published Version; PDF Ad Hoc Networks 151 (2023) 103289
locators: Sections 5.1-5.4 and 6, PDF pages 8-12, Tables 1-2 and Figures 6-8
shared_variables: contact timing and available transfer volume
record.decision_process: On each request, search candidate acquisition paths and their subsequent delivery paths; choose earliest delivery; resource-aware versions deduct allocated contact volume. Requests are processed on arrival, not optimized as a globally optimal batch.
record.execution_connection: CGR permits local route choices; MSR prescribes preferred routes with CGR fallback if unavailable. Actual paths need not reproduce the scheduler's ideal capacity allocation.
record.experiment_object: Discrete-event simulation: 16 satellites, 25 targets, 6 gateways. Five schemes, nominal contacts and probabilistic contact failures.
record.result_boundary: Resource-aware/MSR variants deliver more requests under nominal conditions, while delivered-only mean latency may be higher. record.version: final_published_version_in_institutional_repository

locators: Sections 5.1-5.4 and 6, PDF pages 8-12, Tables 1-2 and Figures 6-8
shared_variables: contact timing and available transfer volume
record.decision_process: On each request, search candidate acquisition paths and their subsequent delivery paths; choose earliest delivery; resource-aware versions deduct allocated contact volume. Requests are processed on arrival, not optimized as a globally optimal batch.
record.execution_connection: CGR permits local route choices; MSR prescribes preferred routes with CGR fallback if unavailable. Actual paths need not reproduce the scheduler's ideal capacity allocation.
record.experiment_object: Discrete-event simulation: 16 satellites, 25 targets, 6 gateways. Five schemes, nominal contacts and probabilistic contact failures.
record.result_boundary: Resource-aware/MSR variants deliver more requests under nominal conditions, while delivered-only mean latency may be higher. Contact failures reduce benefits of prespecified routes; storage and energy are infinite in this implementation; allocated capacity is not reallocated for later arrivals.

record.source_version: arXiv 2604.05937v1 author preprint dated 2026-04-07; publisher page identifies this as a prior preprint of the published manuscript; differences not fully checked

claims.fact: P_obs maximizes observation profit based on image quality using binary window/order decisions with time, attitude, and energy constraints. Storage is neglected under dynamic processing. SCIP is used for this ILP.

P_sch uses acquired workload and available downlink schedules as inputs, choosing fractional workload allocation x and processing frequency f to minimize processing plus transmission energy, with processing, ISL and downlink capacity limits. Substituting the frequency expression reduces the stated problem to a convex formulation.

The pipeline scatters data captured at slot k in the same slot, processes in k+1, and gathers for downlink in k+2. Intra-space links are assumed stable/fixed, whereas the ground feeder endpoint and rate can vary.

The processing experiments compare CPU/GPU edge configurations and ground processing under specified loads. Benefits depend on hardware, load and slot length; the longest slot is not simply the best operational choice because observation arrivals can overlap ongoing processing.

claims.interpretation: The concrete implementation combines an acquisition schedule with downstream workload/frequency optimization through a pipeline. It should not be described as a single global optimization jointly choosing observation windows, processor placement and unrestricted routing, or as an already demonstrated feedback controller from processing bottlenecks to acquisition.

core_audit_round1_records.title: A Hybrid Forecasting Model for Self-Similar Traffic in LEO Mega-Constellation Networks

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 业务需求预测与波束、功率及频谱分配
manuscript_occurrences.text: 非均匀需求使固定照射与平均资源分配难以同时兼顾资源利用和业务满足。波束跳变通过时分照射覆盖多个区域，其资源配置涉及离散照射选择与连续功率分配。Han等[73](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11030191)结合经验模态分解、ARIMA与优化神经网络，预测具有自相似特征的业务流量，为需求感知调度提供负载估计。波束与功率优化进一步确定有限容量的分配，其评价指标包括供需差距、吞吐和时延，与流量预测误差具有不同的业务含义。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 流量预测[73](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11030191) | 未来业务量 | 自相似负载；预测模型 | 负载估计通过后续调度影响服务效果 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.3 分布式与学习方法的信息条件
manuscript_occurrences.text: 学习方法在上述信息条件下承担不同决策职责。流量预测[73](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11030191)生成未来负载估计；学习辅助大邻域搜索[63](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2025.128502)提供初解，再由破坏—修复搜索形成计划；单星策略复用[65](https://doi.org/10.2514/1.A35736)直接影响成员的在线选择；带安全屏蔽的策略[96](https://doi.org/10.1007/s40295-026-00631-w)在巡检任务中结合动作生成与安全约束。预测、搜索初解和策略动作的改进分别通过后续优化、协调或约束处理影响运行结果。训练阶段的联合信息与执行阶段的成员状态也属于不同信息集合，学习与分布式方法的结合效果取决于局部可得状态对任务安排和冲突消解的支持程度。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.5 研究挑战与发展方向
manuscript_occurrences.text: **学习模块对最终运行结果的贡献。** 预测[73](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11030191)、学习初解与搜索修复[63](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2025.128502)、受安全屏蔽的动作生成[96](https://doi.org/10.1007/s40295-026-00631-w)分别作用于不同决策环节。局部误差或动作质量的改善经资源竞争、协调和约束处理后，可能产生不同的最终收益。其向任务交付或持续服务传递的条件，以及需求变化、通信受限和能力降级对这一过程的影响，构成学习方法的系统评价问题。结合模块职责分析训练投入、后续修复与回退结果，有助于识别学习方法对整体方案的实际贡献。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 业务需求预测与波束、功率及频谱分配
manuscript_occurrences.text: 多星重叠覆盖引入了服务关联和跨星干扰约束。Lin等[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)依次优化卫星—小区关联与照射模式，同时考虑负载平衡及对地球同步轨道系统的同频干扰。Zhao等[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)结合数字孪生与多智能体学习，根据预测需求和队列状态配置多星波束及星内功率。其[公开预印本](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.08896v1)采用12星、每星4波束、总计168小区的模型，限制同一小区的服务关联及功率预算。与单星配置相比，多星模型还需协调重叠覆盖中的重复服务、成员间干扰和排队差异。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 业务需求预测与波束、功率及频谱分配
manuscript_occurrences.text: 上述模型的分解方式与协调对象存在差异。波束—功率配置[74](https://doi.org/10.23919/JCC.ja.2022-0864)和需求感知配置[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)分别处理离散选束与连续功率，多星共存模型[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)则分阶段确定服务关联与照射模式。三类方法对应单星供需匹配、多星资源协调和共存干扰等不同约束。学习方法将部分计算转移至训练阶段，并依赖全局状态或局部观测。因此，联合配置方法的适用范围与其协调尺度、信息条件和计算成本密切相关。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 多星与GSO共存[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912) | 服务关联与照射模式 | 负载平衡及共存干扰约束 | 跨星分配同时受到关联和外部干扰限制 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.2 从局部活动到最终服务的资源耦合
manuscript_occurrences.text: 通信资源耦合作用于持续业务流。单星波束—功率配置[74](https://doi.org/10.23919/JCC.ja.2022-0864)通过连续资源调整改变供需匹配，多星关联和共存模型[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)纳入成员之间及外部系统的干扰约束，需求感知配置[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)中的策略差异随总负载改变。路径时延参与接入选择[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)，容量竞争与故障进入地面中继路由[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)，激光链路建立则增加路径更新代价[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)。资源耦合的作用由这些具体瓶颈决定：照射区域、接入对象和瞬时最短路分别描述服务过程的一部分，功率、后续容量及动作生效时间共同限定实际可获得的服务。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 星地接入、卫星切换与业务连续性
manuscript_occurrences.text: Yin等[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)将端到端传播时延估计纳入切换评价，采用Dueling Double DQN处理单层切换，并在跨层切换中结合时延抖动预测与切换开销。该方法将接入决策的评价范围扩展至后续网络路径，其仿真结果反映路径评价、预测与学习机制共同作用下的整体策略性能。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 路由代价感知切换[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039) | 接入对象与连接保持 | 路径时延、抖动及切换开销 | 接入选择同时考虑端到端路径质量 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.2 从局部活动到最终服务的资源耦合
manuscript_occurrences.text: 通信资源耦合作用于持续业务流。单星波束—功率配置[74](https://doi.org/10.23919/JCC.ja.2022-0864)通过连续资源调整改变供需匹配，多星关联和共存模型[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)纳入成员之间及外部系统的干扰约束，需求感知配置[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)中的策略差异随总负载改变。路径时延参与接入选择[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)，容量竞争与故障进入地面中继路由[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)，激光链路建立则增加路径更新代价[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)。资源耦合的作用由这些具体瓶颈决定：照射区域、接入对象和瞬时最短路分别描述服务过程的一部分，功率、后续容量及动作生效时间共同限定实际可获得的服务。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.5 研究挑战与发展方向
manuscript_occurrences.text: **端到端服务目标下的适度联合。** 接触图调度[106](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.adhoc.2023.103289)共同选择采集与交付路径，观测—处理安排[53](https://doi.org/10.1002/sat.70082)利用既有采集计划配置下游资源；需求感知波束[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)、路由代价感知切换[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)和动态激光链路路由[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)分别引入负载、端到端路径和建链代价。上述差异表明，联合范围取决于后续条件对当前任务或路径选择的影响，以及顺序输入和运行反馈保留这些作用的程度。相同请求、负载与扰动条件下的联合、顺序和反馈模型比较，可通过交付量、时延、计算及协调开销揭示联合范围扩大的收益和代价。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 动态拓扑、星间路由与拥塞恢复
manuscript_occurrences.text: Zhang和Yeung[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)面向无星间链路、地面站辅助的低轨网络，采用分层路由协调路径时延与稳定性。Zhang等[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)同样研究地面中继网络，通过分段路由实现流量工程和故障重路由。前者主要降低正常拓扑演化中的路径更新负担，后者进一步处理容量分配及失效恢复。上述方法的适用对象是地面辅助网络，其链路结构与直接激光星间转发不同。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.1 求解机制与可扩展性
manuscript_occurrences.text: 局部化与计划复用在降低计算负担的同时，涉及计划质量与协调范围的权衡。Parjan和Chien[34](https://doi.org/10.2514/1.I011215)在连续规划实验中发现，增量修改的计算速度优于重新生成计划，但产生了更多重复观测。Zilberstein等[35](https://doi.org/10.1613/jair.1.16997)利用几何邻域划分局部问题，在大规模算例中降低最慢代理的计算时间和消息量，任务满足率与比较方法仍存在差距。前者复用已有安排，后者限制协调范围，二者分别通过时间延续性和空间局部性组织计算。地面辅助的稳定路由[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)同样减少路径更新负担，动态激光链路路由[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)则表明路径保持的时延收益取决于建链代价。计划复用与路径保持均利用既有决策的连续性，其效果分别受重复任务、机会损失及动作成本影响。表8归纳主要技术机制及其取舍。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 动态拓扑、星间路由与拥塞恢复
manuscript_occurrences.text: Zhang和Yeung[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)面向无星间链路、地面站辅助的低轨网络，采用分层路由协调路径时延与稳定性。Zhang等[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)同样研究地面中继网络，通过分段路由实现流量工程和故障重路由。前者主要降低正常拓扑演化中的路径更新负担，后者进一步处理容量分配及失效恢复。上述方法的适用对象是地面辅助网络，其链路结构与直接激光星间转发不同。

manuscript_occurrences.section: ### 跨域资源分配与控制职责
manuscript_occurrences.text: | 分层及分段路由[79](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comcom.2022.02.015)、[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022) | 路径稳定、流量与恢复 | 无直接星间链路的地面辅助网络 | 更新组织、容量分配和失效恢复具有不同职责 |

manuscript_occurrences.section: ## 4.2 从局部活动到最终服务的资源耦合
manuscript_occurrences.text: 通信资源耦合作用于持续业务流。单星波束—功率配置[74](https://doi.org/10.23919/JCC.ja.2022-0864)通过连续资源调整改变供需匹配，多星关联和共存模型[75](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3213912)纳入成员之间及外部系统的干扰约束，需求感知配置[76](https://doi.org/10.1109/TWC.2025.3545745)中的策略差异随总负载改变。路径时延参与接入选择[77](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cja.2024.09.039)，容量竞争与故障进入地面中继路由[80](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcan.2022.09.022)，激光链路建立则增加路径更新代价[121](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAES.2024.3415571)。资源耦合的作用由这些具体瓶颈决定：照射区域、接入对象和瞬时最短路分别描述服务过程的一部分，功率、后续容量及动作生效时间共同限定实际可获得的服务。
